scenario: 社区搜索（UGC短文本）：关注相关性、点击率及语义检索、排序和大模型部署成本。

papers.title: Acceptance Is Not Speed: Length Inflation in Training-Free Lossy Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Chiatzen Wang, Bill Xu, Haochen Gu, Hongyang Zhang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.23818v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Speculative decoding typically characterizes speedup by draft tokens accepted per verification round. Lossless verification preserves the target model's output distribution and thus expected completion length, making this metric a meaningful efficiency proxy. Relaxed (lossy) verification accepts tokens that lossless verification would reject, potentially altering that distribution. We identify a length inflation phenomenon: relaxed verification lengthens completions, primarily by extending reasoning traces, largely offsetting apparent gains in accepted tokens per round. We evaluate existing training-free relaxed verification rules on twelve target-drafter pairs against lossless verification on identical prompts, measuring completion length, verifier rounds, wall-clock time, and task accuracy. At each rule's most relaxed evaluated setting, relaxed verification on average accepts $1.34\times$ as many tokens per round but produces $1.54\tim
papers.summary: 放宽草稿验证可能让回答更长，抵消看似更高的解码效率。作者用相同提示对比宽松验证与无损验证，同时统计回答长度、验证轮数和耗时。最宽松设置下，每轮接受量平均增加到原来的1.34倍，回答却延长到1.54倍。
papers.key_insight: 接受更多草稿词，并不等于更快完成任务。推理压测要同时记录完整请求耗时、输出长度和最终答案正确率。尤其是推理型模型，延长思考可能耗尽回答预算，单看每轮接受量会掩盖这笔开销。

papers.title: Where Prefill Expert Reduction Hurts MoE Models: A Few Prompt Tokens Carry Most of the Short-Answer F1 Loss
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.22454v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Running prompt tokens through fewer routed experts during prefill is a simple way to make mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving cheaper, yet it is unclear what this damages. We locate the damage with token-, layer- and attention-path interventions on short-answer question answering in four MoE families. At half the experts the F1 loss of three families is mostly answer form: the model still finds the answer but stops answering briefly. In Qwen3-30B-A3B this loss is made at the two chat-template tokens before the answer, and in DeepSeek-V2-Lite at the first 8-32 prompt tokens, where its instruction sits; by answer likelihood these positions account for about half and a fifth of the damage. Reduction changes the first token's attention mass, norm and largest activation by less than 4%, and restoring super experts or massive activations recovers at most about a quarter of the loss, well below keeping the sensitive positions full. On real prompts
papers.summary: 减少提示阶段调用的专家能省算力，但少数关键位置可能承担大部分质量损失。作者逐词、逐层干预，发现保留任务接口附近的完整专家计算，比随机保留文档位置更有效。在长提示实验中，首词延迟约降低14%。
papers.key_insight: 专家预算可以按提示位置分配，不必全段统一压缩。任务指令和答案边界值得保留更多计算。但现有实验中关键位置也都位于提示两端，尚不能区分接口识别与简单保留两端的效果。

papers.title: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
papers.authors: Jiaming Xu, Hanzhen Wang, Tianlang Zhao, Jiewen Xiao, Chengze Yuan, Jiayi Pan, Yongkang Zhou, Jiancai Ye, Yu Wang, Guohao Dai
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.23787v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local
papers.summary: 多轮智能体的历史越来越长，草稿模型维护历史缓存也越来越贵。这项工作直接复用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态，用轻量预测头生成草稿，再用顺序模块补回块内依赖。实验报告，相对DSpark的提升最高达到70%。
papers.key_insight: 历史上下文不一定要在草稿侧再保存一份。目标模型已计算出的状态可以承担上下文表达，草稿侧只负责局部续写。收益来自减少重复状态和维护开销，而非单纯把草稿模型缩小。

papers.title: Accelerated Dataflow: scaling inference in streaming data analytics with efficiency
papers.authors: RuiLong Jiang, Dustin Rhodes, Danny McCormick, Yuta Labur, Reza Rokni
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.22731v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Streaming data analytics helps businesses identify opportunities and spot risks in a timely fashion. As large language model (LLM) usage grows, people are exploring incorporating agents or LLMs in streaming data pipelines to help find patterns in datasets without supervision or interpret natural languages for content moderation. However, most streaming systems are currently optimized for data movement and perform poorly on GPU intensive workloads such as performing inference with LLMs. We introduce a system on Google Cloud Dataflow designed to tackle hybrid streaming machine learning workloads with co-designed autoscaling on heterogeneous worker pools and prefix-aware batching. This increases throughput 1.5x to 2x for streaming pipelines using LLMs while maintaining similar latency with up to 75% peak resource savings and 84% lower peak tail latency compared with existing streaming data processing systems.
papers.summary: 流计算平台接入大模型后，瓶颈从数据搬运转向推理计算。Google Cloud Dataflow把不同资源类型的工作池联合扩缩容，并将相同提示前缀的请求合批，减少重复计算。论文报告，流式大模型管线吞吐提高到原来的1.5至2倍，延迟保持相近。
papers.key_insight: 扩缩容与合批需要一起设计。只增加推理设备，未必能解决上游数据供给或批次组织的问题。对于持续到达的UGC处理任务，前缀复用率和各阶段排队时间值得纳入资源调度依据。

papers.title: Reusing Calibration Gains across Model Representations
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.22771v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scale calibration learns an update for one model representation. We study how much of that update can be reused by another representation of the same pretrained model. Our transfer procedure extracts positive group-wise gains and installs them in the recipient's weights or native quantization scales without recipient-side optimization. On a quantized recipient, it preserves integer codes, zero points and storage layout. For a Qwen3-1.7B floating-point/GPTQ INT3 pair, bidirectional transfer retains 76.9-90.5% of the text-loss improvement from recipient-specific calibration on fresh WikiText and C4 cohorts excluded from project development. Shuffling the same gain values within each projection worsens both recipients, showing that their learned group assignment matters after transfer. A Llama-3.2-3B control keeps the initial native tensors at all four calibrated projections identical and changes nine projections elsewhere. Cross-installati
papers.summary: 同一模型换成量化版本后，校准结果不一定要从头重学。作者把分组缩放增益移植到另一种表示的权重或量化尺度，保持整数编码及存储布局不变。在Qwen3浮点与低比特配对实验中，保留了专门校准收益的76.9%至90.5%。
papers.key_insight: 可复用的是带有分组对应关系的校准增益，而不只是数值分布。打乱增益所属位置会使结果变差。维护多个精度版本时，这种对应关系可以减少重复优化，同时保留原有量化文件结构。

papers.title: Simplify AI search with AlloyDB hybrid search and RRF
papers.abstract: AlloyDB combines vector search and full-text search with reciprocal rank fusion for hybrid AI search.
papers.summary: 关键词检索和向量检索各有分数尺度，应用层融合容易变复杂。AlloyDB把两路召回与按名次融合放进同一SQL接口，并提供全文索引及外部搜索接入。文中示例仅需1次声明式SQL调用；这是工程简化示例，不是吞吐提升倍数。
papers.key_insight: 按名次融合能绕开异构分数归一化。社区短文本搜索可以保留关键词精确匹配，再与语义召回合并。索引选择仍有代价：保存词位置有助于排序和短语查询，但会增加索引大小与构建成本。

papers.title: HydraLLM: Adaptive Width Slicing for Elastic Text and Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Oscar Kemme, Janek Haberer, Ali Hojjat, Olaf Landsiedel
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.23455v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLMs and LVLMs are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware, ranging from data-center GPUs to resource-constrained edge devices. Their fixed-size architectures limit the ability to reuse a single model across deployment settings with different compute, latency, and model-size targets. We introduce HydraLLM, an elastic MQA-based architecture. Its number of active attention heads determines the effective widths of the embeddings, attention projections, feed-forward layers, and the output head, forming a nested family of subnetworks within a single parameter set. We introduce a static-to-elastic conversion pipeline that, starting from a pre-trained model checkpoint, includes importance-driven weight reordering and stochastic subnetwork training with knowledge distillation. We extend this principle to multimodal inference through an elastic projection module whose output width follows the active text width. HydraLLM covers a wider
papers.summary: 同一个模型要适配不同设备，通常需要维护多个大小版本。这项工作通过调整活跃注意力头数量，同步改变嵌入、前馈层和输出层宽度，再用蒸馏训练嵌套子网。仅启用四分之一的头时，词元生成吞吐比完整宽度提高75.3%。
papers.key_insight: 模型宽度可以成为部署时可选的资源档位。让多个层的宽度一起变化，能扩大参数与延迟的选择范围。但这种弹性需要专门的权重重排和子网训练，不能只在普通检查点上关闭部分头。

papers.title: SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yuqi Huang, Xingyao Li, Yunlong Hou, Fengzhuo Zhang, Jiachun Pan, Vincent Y. F. Tan
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.18735v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantee
papers.summary: 多模态输入差异大，固定草稿配置难以始终保持高吞吐。这项工作在生成过程中试探不同配置，利用吞吐曲线的单峰特征，选择当前请求更合适的草稿设置。在所测视觉与文本任务上，比原有自投机解码方案最高提升11%。
papers.key_insight: 草稿配置可以在请求内自适应选择。优化目标应包含试探配置花掉的真实时间，避免为了找到更优配置而付出更大开销。单峰假设给出了减少试探次数的依据，适合输入差异较大的多模态服务。

papers.title: Peak-Memory Schedules You Can Trust: Exact Realization, Certified Optimality, and the Limits of Recomputation for Inference
papers.authors: Ivan Fomin, Ivan Koryabkin, Boris Sheludko
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.23328v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Real-time inference on small devices needs low activation memory without extra latency, which makes operator order the most valuable memory lever: it is free in time. We show that the usual way of deploying a better order, handing it back to the compiler and regenerating code, is unreliable. In PyTorch Inductor the regenerated program misses its predicted peak in 22 of 54 CPU configurations. It is worse than the stock program in 9 of them and in 19 of 50 on a GPU, and on the GPU it also changes numerical results. We instead profile the generated program, model its memory exactly from its own statements and their read/write effects, and permute those statements. We prove that this realizes the modeled peak whenever allocation does not depend on history. It does so to the byte, with bitwise-identical results, in all our CPU runs. On the GPU we characterize why the caching allocator breaks the condition. To know when to stop, we give forwar
papers.summary: 调整算子顺序能省内存，但重新编译可能破坏原先预测的峰值。作者直接重排编译后程序的语句，并用读写关系精确建模内存占用。所得顺序在94%的留出包装图上获得最优性证明，避免继续搜索已经没有改进空间的调度。
papers.key_insight: 内存优化需要作用在最终执行程序上。高层计算图中看似更省的顺序，经过编译可能变样。证明当前顺序已最优也有工程价值：它能提示下一步转向重计算或架构调整，而非继续排列算子。

papers.title: CascadeLedger: Counterfactual Auditing of Information and Resource Integrity in LLM Cascades
papers.authors: Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Xiaobo Guo, Xin Wang, Bokun Wang, Daren Zha
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.20668v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: We introduce CascadeLedger, a counterfactual execution-audit framework for budgeted language-model cascades. The protocol enforces call-before-read semantics, binds successful reads to service and cache identities, records availability and component-wise budget transitions, and freezes the event trace before any target or task scorer is joined. The central object is aggregate-equivalent trace validity: two executions can share a final answer, declared resource projection, and service histogram while differing in whether their routing decisions used only legitimately observable information. We complement single-trace invariants with counterfactual prefix non-interference (CPNI), which couples a visible prefix and policy randomness while changing only a declared hidden family. The counterfactual influence frontier (CIF) localizes the earliest violating prefix and a minimal hidden witness; projection-preserving adversarial mutatio
papers.summary: 大模型级联的结果和总开销相同，也可能藏着违规读取或预算记录错误。这项工作将调用、缓存身份和预算变化写成可核对的执行轨迹，再用反事实检查定位信息泄漏。实验对序列化故障的检出率达到99.83%。
papers.key_insight: 成本路由的评估需要保留决策当时可见的信息。只记录最后答案与总调用数，无法发现路由器偷看未付费结果等问题。冻结执行轨迹后再接入任务评分，可将合法执行与答案质量分开审计。
